messages:
Maya R: Quick follow-up from last night's incident (ETL lag + missing service spans). Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/177300. Please skim and add owners.

Liam T: Looking at the pipeline now — preliminary root cause looks like the nightly aggregator falling back to single-thread due to file handle exhaustion. I'm taking ownership of the hotfix. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Sara P: I'll own aggregation correctness tests and add a blocking CI job. Plan: deterministic vector + integration check to catch bad merges. ETA: 48h.

Anita C: Missing spans traced to the telemetry SDK change that dropped trace headers when batch_size > 1. Reverting that change as a stopgap and adding span-coverage alert. @team-telemetry

Jorge M: Can we centralize owners/timelines? I'll create a checklist in the postmortem and add recurrence context (we saw similar symptoms 2025-12-11 and 2026-01-29). Might be topology/config drift.

Maya R: Please add remediation labels and task IDs so SRE/sales can reference impacts. I'll coordinate with PM for Dedicated customers impacted.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/etl-hotfix -> prod at 2026-03-24T03:00Z (canary 10%).

Anita C: Patch PR submitted: #4983. Reverted commit abc123 as temporary rollback. Added unit tests for header propagation.

Liam T: Hotfix merged to release branch, starting 10% canary. Monitoring rule: monitor cpu/etl-lag and per-shard token processing time. If cpu/etl-lag > 500ms for 5m, auto rollback.

Sara P: Added CI job 'agg-guard' that runs the deterministic vector pre-merge. Example alert rule we added:
```
rule: AggOutputMismatch
if: agg_diff > 0
for: 5m
notify: #eng-alerts
```

Maya R: Action items summary (please add task links):
- ETL hotfix (Liam) - deploy by 2026-03-24 EOD
- Aggregation tests & guard (Sara) - 48h, CI blocking
- SDK trace header fix + alert (Anita) - 24h
- Postmortem checklist + recurrence analysis (Jorge) - add links + next steps
- Customer comms draft (Maya) - draft by tomorrow noon
Link to tasks board: https://tasks.redwood/org/INC-789

Jorge M: Filing a tracking ticket INC-7891 for recurring ETL/aggregation incidents. I'll propose a quarterly audit of ETL topology and test coverage.

ops-bot: label applied: incident-type:observability, priority:high

Maya R: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene Fri 10:00am PT to validate fixes and close action items. If any blocker surfaces, ping this thread and @oncall. :thumbsup:
